title: Sadie Sandler to Lead Netflix Horror Film Malibu
excerpt:
Sadie Sandler is taking on her first straight horror feature.
Production on the Tod Williams-directed film is planned for early 2027.
body_md:
After leading the Netflix comedy Roommates, Sadie Sandler is returning to the streaming service for a markedly different project. Malibu will give the actress her first leading opportunity in a film described as straight horror.

The story follows an aspiring actress who accepts a last-minute dog-sitting assignment at the Malibu mansion of a reclusive movie star. She soon discovers that the property is not what she expected. Further details about the nature of the danger have not been disclosed.

Tod "Kip" Williams, whose credits include Paranormal Activity 2, will direct from a screenplay he co-wrote with Tom Pabst, who worked on Titans. Williams also directed Cell, the adaptation of Stephen King's horror novel starring John Cusack and Samuel L. Jackson.

Roy Lee's Vertigo Entertainment, Steven Schneider's Room 101 and Adam Sandler's Happy Madison are producing. Lee's recent work includes Weapons and the horror series It: Welcome to Derry.

Sadie Sandler has previously appeared in the spooky comedy Hubie Halloween and provided voice work for the Hotel Transylvania franchise. Her other credits include Jay Kelly, Happy Gilmore 2 and Nobody Wants This. Malibu represents a shift toward a more serious horror tone.

Production is scheduled to begin in early 2027. Netflix has not yet announced a release date.
